alias_rationale: An alias score of 0.08 vs 0.12 is uninformative. identity found 72% / canonicalized 61% / target relation recovered 19% names the failing mechanism.
delta_definition: delta_r = CES@50(candidate_policy, regime r) - CES@50(P0_bm25, regime r)

holdout_policy.note: Repeatedly inspecting per-regime holdout errors spends it even without explicit tuning. The final run returns the predeclared metrics plus immutable receipts, nothing more.

alias.rule: reported independently; may never be averaged into an aggregate verdict, and no aggregate gain may substitute for it

policy_arms.P3_regime_aware_deterministic: BLOCKED until the alias identity mechanism exists
policy_arms.P4_oracle_regime_policy: ceiling only, never a production arm

reference_arm.name: P0_bm25
reference_arm.rationale: BM25 is the incumbent candidate generator and the strongest single arm measured so far. Frozen as the reference NOW so it cannot be swapped for a weaker baseline after calibration results are seen.

selection_gate.conditional_ceiling_required: P(gold retained by S5 | gold available in pool)
selection_gate.rationale: Low candidate coverage and poor selector performance must not be mixed. The conditional ceiling separates them.
selection_gate.rule: if delta < tau_selection -> FAIL_SELECTION_OPPORTUNITY and S1-S4 are NOT built
selection_gate.statistic: mean HRM verified_quality, S5 minus S0, on identical frozen candidate pools
